notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (fetched via curl_cffi and WebFetch) has no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow, only Allow:/ and standard exclusions (login/checkout/api/etc), so proceeded. Tier 1 (curl_cffi w/ chrome impersonation + WebFetch): homepage (/) returned 200 with full SSR HTML incl. __NEXT_DATA__ and mega-menu links, but every /category/* PLP URL (incl. Christmas/Halloween pages) returned Akamai 'Access Denied' 403 on both tools. Tier 2 (Playwright headless Chromium): 403 on homepage AND category pages alike (stricter bot fingerprinting than curl/WebFetch) - hard block, escalated. Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, real Chrome extension session): homepage and most /category/ pages loaded normally; /category/christmas/shop-all-christmas/ showed a transient 'Powered and protected by [Privacy]' bot-check interstitial on the very first hit but resolved to the real page on a retry navigation a few seconds later (after cookies/session were established by browsing other Kmart pages first) - no further blocks seen afterward. All qty figures below were read directly off the live PLP heading (e.g. '1-60 of 290 Products') in Claude-in-Chrome with the site's default 'Includes Marketplace' toggle ON (the as-loaded default state every PLP shows) - this Kmart AU PLP total includes both Kmart-brand and Kmart Marketplace third-party-seller listings, consistent with what a normal site visitor sees as the category count. TAXONOMY DISCOVERY: fetched sitemap-index.xml -> sitemap/au/category-sitemap.xml (2,893 category URLs) and grepped for christmas|halloween|easter|diwali|deepavali|valentine|thanksgiving|hanukkah|chanukah|ramadan|eid|lunar|new-year|mothers-day|st-patrick|cny keywords (case-insensitive) to find every seasonal/holiday category slug site-wide, then cross-checked against the live main-nav mega-menu (homepage __NEXT_DATA__/DOM hrefs) and each PLP's own breadcrumb trail. RESULT: Christmas and Halloween are the only two holidays with a dedicated category taxonomy on kmart.com.au right now (site date-checked 2026-09-04, i.e. early-Spring AU / pre-Christmas 'pre-order' phase, which is why the Christmas range is still small/ramping). Easter: sitemap contains exactly one Easter URL, /category/easter/easter-plush-toys/, which is a TOY category (plush toys), not home decor, and Easter has no current top-level nav entry (off-season) - concluded NO home-decor Easter category exists right now, not merely absent from search. Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, Diwali/Deepavali, Lunar New Year/CNY, Hanukkah, Ramadan/Eid, St Patrick's Day, New Year: zero sitemap matches for any of these under any plausible slug - concluded absent, not merely unsearched. Father's Day and Mother's Day categories exist but are gifting/apparel hubs, not home-decor seasonal decor, so excluded as out of category scope for this project. SCOPING DECISIONS: 'Shop All Christmas' (https://www.kmart.com.au/category/christmas/shop-all-christmas/, 1164 products incl. marketplace) and 'Shop All Halloween' / 'Home of Halloween' (https://www.kmart.com.au/category/halloween/shop-all-halloween/, 365 products incl. marketplace) are genuine site-taxonomy hub PLPs but their product sets span far beyond home decor (Christmas: family matching pyjamas/apparel; Halloween: costumes, candy, makeup, masks, pet costumes, plush toys, books) per the site's own hub tile menus, so per the parent/grouping rule they are represented below as name-only is_group rows ('Christmas' / 'Halloween') with qty/link null rather than given the mixed-department hub number, and their genuinely home/decor-relevant children are listed individually below with their own site-reported PLP totals. 'Christmas Family Matching Outfits' (apparel, /category/women/family-matching-outfits/) and all Halloween costume/candy/makeup/book/gifting/price-bucket tiles (Costumes & Accessories, Trick or Treat, Makeup & Accessories, Halloween Candy, Halloween Craft, Halloween Pet Costumes, Halloween Plush & Toys, Halloween Books, Halloween Gifting, Halloween $5/$10/$20 & Under) were confirmed via the hub tile list and excluded as non-home/decor per task scope. DUPLICATE/NESTING CHECK: 'Halloween Decor & Lighting' (https://www.kmart.com.au/category/halloween/halloween-decor-and-lighting/, 191 products, the tile the hub itself labels 'Halloween Decorations') breadcrumbs as parent of two child PLPs whose counts sum EXACTLY to it - 'Halloween Decorations' (184, breadcrumb Home>Halloween>Halloween Decor & Lighting>Halloween Decorations) + 'Halloween Light Up Decorations' (7, same nesting) = 191 - confirmed an exact partition via live product-count headings on all three pages, so per the no-double-count rule 'Halloween Decor & Lighting' is recorded as an is_group row and only its two children carry qty. A separate legacy sitemap URL /category/halloween/halloween-decorations/ resolves to the same 184-count page as the nested child (not a distinct duplicate). No other duplicate-link pairs were found (each remaining PLP has a unique product count and its own breadcrumb path).
